products.name: Pure Kanjeevaram Bridal Silk Saree (Crimson Gold)
products.shortDescription: Handwoven in pure mulberry silk with rich 2-gram gold zari brocade korvai border.
products.description: Exquisite bridal heirloom Kanjeevaram silk saree crafted by master weavers. Features a rich intricate zari pallu, contrast temple border, and pure silk mark certification. Includes unstitched blouse piece.

products.name: Floral Embroidered Festive Anarkali Kurti
products.shortDescription: Regal emerald green silk-blend kurti with hand zardozi and mirror work embroidery.
products.description: Turn heads at every festive gathering in this flared anarkali kurti featuring intricate gota patti neckline, flared tier hem, and quarter sleeves. Soft cotton inner lining ensures all-day celebration comfort.

products.name: Banarasi Brocade Silk Saree with Zari Pallu
products.shortDescription: Royal sapphire blue Banarasi katan silk woven with silver and antique gold zari booti.
products.description: Woven in the historic looms of Varanasi, this katan silk masterpiece reflects timeless royal grandeur with floral kadwa zari motifs and heavy border.

products.name: Men's Raw Silk Festive Kurta & Dhoti Set
products.shortDescription: Champagne gold raw silk long kurta with mandarin collar and matching pure silk dhoti.
products.description: Traditional elegance redefined for weddings and rituals. Made with 100% pure raw silk with fine mother-of-pearl buttons and matching border dhoti.

products.name: Handcrafted Pure Tussar Silk Saree with Madhubani Art
products.shortDescription: Earthy golden honey tussar silk featuring authentic hand-painted Madhubani floral stories.
products.description: Artisanal organic tussar silk saree with naturally coarse rich texture and hand-painted folk motifs along the pallu.

products.name: Girls Traditional Pattu Pavadai Silk Frock (Pink Gold)
products.shortDescription: Vibrant rani pink pure silk skirt with heavy gold zari border and embroidered top.
products.description: Adorable traditional South Indian festive wear for young girls. Soft pure silk with comfortable inner lining.

products.name: Hand Block-Printed Chanderi Dress Material (3-Piece)
products.shortDescription: Lavender and pastel mauve unstitched suit set with pure Chanderi silk dupatta.
products.description: Premium unstitched 3-piece dress material containing 2.5m Chanderi top, 2.5m soft cotton bottom, and 2.5m printed zari border dupatta. Breathable and luxurious for office and day festive occasions.

products.name: Pure Organic Cotton Floral Running Fabric (Per Meter)
products.shortDescription: 60s count cambric cotton fabric with delicate botanical floral prints. 44-inch width.
products.description: High-density, soft breathable organic cotton running meterage ideal for tailoring custom Kurtis, summer dresses, men shirts, and baby clothing. Pre-shrunk with azo-free organic dyes.

products.name: Artisan Indigo Dabu Hand-Block Print Fabric (Per Meter)
products.shortDescription: Mud-resist mud printed artisanal indigo natural dyed cotton fabric from Bagru, Rajasthan.
products.description: True artisanal textile craft. Crafted using natural fermentation indigo vats and traditional wooden blocks. Each meter carries the signature organic depth of authentic hand-dyeing.

products.name: Smocked Tiered Cotton Summer Midi Dress
products.shortDescription: Breezy lilac pastel dress with shirred elastic bodice and flowy tiered skirt.
products.description: Effortless daytime chic tailored from 100% pure mulmul cotton. Features square neckline, puff sleeves, and a tiered midi silhouette.

products.name: Pure Linen Handloom Shirting & Kurta Fabric
products.shortDescription: 80 lea European flax pure linen running fabric for luxury shirts, kurtas and jackets.
products.description: Crisp, thermoregulating pure linen with signature natural slub texture. Softens gracefully with every wash.

products.name: Zari Brocade Jacquard Blouse & Craft Fabric (1 Meter)
products.shortDescription: Lustrous antique gold floral jacquard brocade fabric cut for bridal blouses and dupattas.
products.description: Richly textured metallic brocade fabric that adds opulent festive sparkle to any designer saree or lehenga ensemble.
